name: Look-elsewhere Effect
definition: Searching many tests or locations increases the chance of apparently impressive findings, which can be overstated if multiplicity is ignored.
boundary: The statistical effect need not involve dishonesty; distinguish exploratory discovery from confirmatory evidence.
